shortDescription: NetApp Element Software Manage Access Groups

options.name: account_id
options.description: Account ID for the owner of this volume. It accepts either account_name or account_id if account_id is digit, it will consider as account_id If account_id is string, it will consider as account_name

options.name: attributes
options.description: List of Name/Value pairs in JSON object format.

options.name: from_name
options.description: ID or Name of the access group to rename. Required to create a new access group called 'name' by renaming 'from_name'.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the SolidFire cluster. For na_elementsw_cluster, the Management IP (MIP) or hostname of the node to initiate the cluster creation from.

options.name: initiators
options.description: List of initiators to include in the access group. If unspecified, the access group will start out without configured initiators.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the access group for create, modify and delete operations.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified access group should exist or not.

options.name: username
options.description: Please ensure that the user has the adequate permissions. For more information, please read the official documentation U(https://mysupport.netapp.com/documentation/docweb/index.html?productID=62636&language=en-US).

options.name: virtual_network_id
options.description: The ID of the Element SW Software Cluster Virtual Network to associate the access group with.

options.name: virtual_network_tags
options.description: The tags of VLAN Virtual Network Tag to associate the access group with.

options.name: volumes
options.description: List of volumes to initially include in the volume access group. If unspecified, the access group will start without any volumes. It accepts either volume_name or volume_id
